templateOnly: Couldn't reach Claude, so this is the template.

catchUp.title: Catch-up for parents
catchUp.about: Missed every lesson on a concept. Their parents get a short voice note in the home language, with an activity to do at home.

rechecks.title: Quick re-checks
rechecks.about: Patterns seen once. A fresh A, B and C, marked by tap: two or three minutes in group time.

probeGroup.title: Probe group
probeGroup.about: Taught but not learned, seen once. The step-down probe finds where each child can restart.

reteachGroup.title: Reteaching group
reteachGroup.about: Taught but not learned, confirmed. Reteach from the concept they restart at.

recheck.title: Quick re-check: {{concept}}
recheck.noRecheckQuestion: There's no re-check question for this concept yet, so this uses the weekly question's numbers.
recheck.tapEach: {{step}}. Tap each box: right, then wrong
